policy.description: Maintainability hotspot baseline and budget policy (M6). Production source files in internal/, cmd/, and web/src/ (excluding tests) exceeding default_max_lines must be explicitly registered in baseline_files or exceptions with a reviewed max_lines ceiling, owner, and rationale/removal_condition.

internal/handlers/queue.go.rationale: Canonical event-scoped queue HTTP adapter (reduced from 742 lines after retiring songbook-scoped compatibility routes).

internal/handlers/auth.go.rationale: Authentication HTTP adapter covering registration, login, refresh, verification, profile updates, and password reset endpoints.

internal/handlers/passkey.go.rationale: WebAuthn/FIDO2 passkey registration and login transport ceremony adapter.

internal/handlers/songbook.go.rationale: Songbook and catalog HTTP adapter (reduced from 1,076 lines in Stage B and 616 lines after retiring legacy sync endpoints).

internal/event/service.go.rationale: Event lifecycle service owning creation, M11 versioned settings updates, M3b resumable restart batches, and M3c retention cleanup.

internal/account/service.go.rationale: Account export and M7/M14 multi-step cascading account deletion recovery service.

internal/reference/compiler.go.rationale: Canonical reference catalog dictionary and disc map compiler.

internal/queue/service.go.rationale: Canonical queue admission, stage command, rotation transition, and versioned mutation service.

web/src/pages/kj/Songbooks.jsx.rationale: KJ songbook management page (CRUD, song overrides, sync triggers, and import launcher).

web/src/pages/Docs.jsx.rationale: Static developer and platform documentation page; candidate for contract-sourced extraction under Stage D.

web/src/components/SongRequestModal.jsx.rationale: Singer song request submission modal (pitch shift, singer name, favorites memory, and submission handling).

web/src/pages/kj/components/ShowSettings.rationale: Host show configuration modal extracted from LiveQueue.jsx in Stage C.

web/src/pages/singer/hooks/useCatalogSea.rationale: Singer catalog search and Web Worker coordination hook extracted from PublicBook.jsx in Stage C.

web/src/pages/singer/PublicBook.jsx.rationale: Decomposed in Stage C from 2,156 lines to 457 lines; capped to prevent coordinator regression.

web/src/pages/Kiosk.jsx.rationale: Decomposed in Stage C from 894 lines to 422 lines; capped to prevent coordinator regression.

web/src/pages/kj/LiveQueue.jsx.rationale: Decomposed in Stage C from 2,984 lines to 335 lines; capped to prevent coordinator regression.

web/src/components/SingerQueueModal.jsx.rationale: Decomposed in Stage C from 840 lines to 136 lines; capped to prevent coordinator regression.

web/src/components/AssistantImport.jsx.rationale: Decomposed in Stage C from 882 lines to 118 lines; capped to prevent coordinator regression.

internal/catalog/service.go.rationale: Owns catalog manifest reading, song overrides, and M8 recoverable import dispatch/upload completion/reconciliation (reduced from 955 lines after retiring legacy DynamoDB song/sync paths).
internal/catalog/service.go.removal_condition: Split import job lifecycle/reconciliation orchestration from catalog manifest/override read-write operations when internal/catalog next adds or modifies import or catalog workflows.
